create_managed_vector_store: create a managed vector store across multiple models with a unified ID using the litellm proxy
list_vector_stores: list all vector stores created by a user with pagination support using the litellm proxy
check_vector_store_access: check if a user has access to a specific managed vector store by its unified ID
handle_vector_store_pre_call_hook: handle pre-call hook for vector store search operations that validates access and transforms unified IDs to provider IDs
filter_deployments_by_vector_store: filter healthy deployments to only those that have the requested vector store available
